summary.text: Customers find the thermos to be of good quality, with positive feedback about its appearance, design, and portability for travel. The heat retention receives mixed reviews - while some say it keeps water hot for a long time, others report it doesn't maintain temperature. Moreover, reliability and leakage are also mixed aspects, with some customers reporting no issues while others mention heat not working and leakage problems. Value for money receives positive feedback, with customers saying it's worth the price.
